# Example for --debug-inject-file: one addr=value per line (hex).
# Paste from VICE monitor after `m 0100 01ff` (convert to 0100=.. 0101=..).
# Order with C64.py: --debug-inject-file test/fixtures/debug_inject_stack.example.txt
# then optional --debug-inject-map for regs/ZP (map overrides file on duplicate addrs).

0100=fd
0101=fc
0102=fb
